messages.content: Write a monthly engineering update for a team of twelve, covering a migration, two hires, and a slipped deadline. Around 200 words.

Team update — August

We finished the database migration this week, two weeks later than planned. The extra time went to a replication lag issue we didn't catch in staging: under production write volume, the new cluster fell behind enough to serve stale reads for a few seconds during peak traffic. We added a lag-aware routing check before cutting over for real, and it's been stable since.

On the slipped deadline: the original estimate didn't account for testing under production load, so we're building a load-replay step into the next migration's plan instead of finding out the hard way again.

Two hires joined this month. Priya starts on the platform team next week, coming from a background in distributed systems. Marcus joined the frontend team and is already picking up the design system.

A few other notes:
- The old migration scripts are still in the repo for reference; we'll clean those up next sprint.
- On-call rotation adds Priya starting in October, after ramp-up.
- If you hit any lingering issues from the migration, flag them in #eng-infra rather than filing a ticket — we're triaging directly this week.

Thanks for the patience on the timeline. Questions welcome anytime.
